name: Battle of Hastings
summary: William the Conqueror defeats King Harold II, who is killed (likely by an arrow) as the Saxon shield wall breaks under repeated Norman cavalry charges and feigned retreats. The conquest that follows transforms England's language, aristocracy, legal system, and architecture, French-speaking Norman nobles replace the Anglo-Saxon thegnhood within a generation.

_quarry.structural_significance: Fundamentally reshapes English culture, language, and feudal structure; creates the Anglo-Norman realm that dominates 12th-century politics; William's Domesday Book (1086) becomes the most detailed administrative survey of any medieval kingdom
